features.feature_value: Remove posts that unfairly attack a demographic or come from a position of hate
features.evidence_span: remove posts that seemed to unfairly attack a demographic or if they did not provide any real explanations
features.rationale: The participant explicitly states a keep/remove rule tied to unfair demographic attack and hate.

features.feature_value: Compare original vs mirror by adherence to the core topic, and consider whether content is unsafe/overly violent
features.evidence_span: compared both posts to see how much they adhered to that core topic
features.rationale: They describe a specific comparison method (core-topic adherence) plus safety concerns.

features.feature_value: Let go of personal agreement; focus on how inflammatory the statements are
features.evidence_span: struggled to put aside my own feelings and views... Rather, my concern shifted to how inflammatory these statements are
features.rationale: They state that rather than ideological alignment, perceived inflammatory impact drove decisions.

features.feature_value: Remove direct name-calling/personal insults and egregious profanity
features.evidence_span: removing direct name-calling and personal insults
features.rationale: They clearly list these content types as removal drivers.

features.feature_value: Base decisions on how ignorant or incendiary the statements are
features.evidence_span: made based on how ignorant or incendiary the statements were
features.rationale: The participant directly links their decision to perceived ignorance/incitement.

features.feature_value: Assess whether claims have some resemblance of facts rather than being just general hate speech
features.evidence_span: liklihood that it was based on some semblence of fact rather than just general hate speech
features.rationale: They describe a factuality vs hate-speech criterion informing decisions.

features.feature_value: Remove when posts are just stupid insults and too short/insubstantial
features.evidence_span: just stupid insults and short, why have it.
features.rationale: They indicate that insult-only, minimal content is grounds for removal.

features.feature_value: Remove content seen as radicalized, incoherent, or like something from a mentally ill person
features.evidence_span: so radicalized that they don’t even know what theyre saying
features.rationale: They characterize the rhetoric as extreme/disordered and imply it affects removal.
